_style.note: Formal address: ທ່ານ (you) in longer UI sentences and ກະລຸນາ (please) for requests; the app is called ແອັບ. Lao has no spaces between words; a space marks a clause or phrase break, as in the UI. Numbers always use digits 0-9 (never Lao digits ໐-໙), as the app shows them. Keep Latin acronyms and product names (WBS, SNET, Ribbon, Undo) as in the UI.
_style.commands: Short imperative verb without a subject, as in the UI buttons and menus: Save = ບັນທຶກ, Open = ເປີດ, Delete = ລຶບ, Cancel = ຍົກເລີກ, Calculate = ຄິດໄລ່.
_style.quotes: “…” (curly double quotes), also around placeholders (“{{name}}”). A single ‘{{name}}’ is used in the UI only for a task name at the start of a sentence; follow the source.
_style.docs: Guides: formal address (ທ່ານ) as in the UI, polite but plain. A UI label stays exactly as in the UI, in italics, with a carrier word (dialog, tab, button, column) before it. Step: 'Choose *Save*.' → 'ເລືອກ *ບັນທຶກ*.'; 'in the *Relation type* dialog' → 'ໃນກ່ອງໂຕ້ຕອບ *ປະເພດສາຍພົວພັນ*'. Explanation: 'The app moves the successor to the next workday.' → 'ແອັບຈະຍ້າຍໜ້າວຽກຖັດໄປໄປຍັງມື້ເຮັດວຽກຖັດໄປ.' Address: 'If you change the duration, your schedule is out of date.' → 'ຖ້າທ່ານປ່ຽນໄລຍະເວລາ ແຜນງານຂອງທ່ານຈະບໍ່ເປັນປັດຈຸບັນ.'
